layout: Full 16:9 external camera; complete 2:1 panorama inset; sequential routes

scenes.title: Office
scenes.instruction:
Walk straight to the glass wall, then turn right
and stop in front of the large TV set.

scenes.title: Hallway
scenes.instruction:
Turn left and go straight.
Walk until you reach the red carpet and stop.

scenes.title: Campus
scenes.instruction:
Go straight. On the left, there is a brown recliner.
Walk over there and stop.
